task.description: Queue-drain pass for ISS-0151 / GH #468: zig build test-env-verify check C3 reports BPM_DB_URL missing even though .env defines it, because tools/verify_test_env.py reads only the process environment. Fix the checker's environment resolution to load .env the same way the rest of the toolchain does. HARD CONSTRAINT per CLAUDE.md 'Never Satisfy a Gate by Editing What It Measures': do NOT remove, default, soften, or make-unreachable check C3. A workspace genuinely missing BPM_DB_URL must still FAIL C3 -- prove this by testing both directions.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test-env-verify exits 0 on a workspace whose .env defines BPM_DB_URL, with no manual export
A workspace genuinely missing BPM_DB_URL still fails C3 -- verified by test, both directions
Check C3 not removed, defaulted, or weakened

result.summary: ISS-0151/GH #468 fixed in tools/verify_test_env.py. Root cause: the tool resolved BPM_DB_URL inconsistently with itself -- C7 already consulted .env via dotenv_has(), while C3/C4/C6 read only os.environ, so a workspace whose .env correctly defined BPM_DB_URL failed the gate unless the operator had manually exported it. Fix generalises dotenv_has() into dotenv_get() and adds load_dotenv_into_environ(), called once at the top of main(), which exports .env values into os.environ ONLY for keys the process environment lacks (bench.zig resolveDbUrl precedence: real env always wins). Exporting into os.environ rather than teaching each check to read .env is required because zig build migrate (src/tools/migrate.zig) and verify_schema_baseline.py are subprocesses that read their own environment and never parse .env. check_migrate() (C3) itself is byte-for-byte unchanged -- git diff shows zero lines touched in its body -- so its failure path, condition and message are intact per the CLAUDE.md no-silencing-the-detector rule. VERIFIED BOTH DIRECTIONS: (1) .env defines BPM_DB_URL, no shell export -> zig build test-env-verify exits 0, all 7 checks PASS. (2) BPM_DB_URL commented out of .env AND unset in env -> C3 still FAILS with the original message and exit 1. .env restored byte-identical (md5 b3d947cf44e30a7220e426d3f6086328 before and after). Regressions clean: python tools/lint_test_wiring.py exit 0 (252 files reachable), zig build exit 0.
